title: Qualify opened I-005 commands with 1000 seeded random undo
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: 1000 seeded random sequences over already-opened MoveClips (reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks true/false), ripple delete/close/trim, SetCaptions and SetMarkers undo to an equal content hash (revision excluded).
A locked host or a negative timeline start refuses the whole group and leaves captions and markers unchanged. Source-anchored cues are never silently dropped.

Document applyEdit is a pure function: before and start hashes stay equal after every success or refusal. Workspace journal undo of 1000 mutating NLE edits restores the start hash; redo restores the post-edit hash.

A short UI/SDK path covers one persistent host move with a default clipLocal cue and an absolute marker, undo/redo, archive fork, VTT sidecar, and refused preview/MP4 burn-in. After a fork, IDs may be remapped; assertions use text, kind, and time.

Already-delivered leave-gap, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen ripple trim, reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval / source-window, and marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval stay unchanged. Lifting a clipLocal marker host is still an atomic REF_NOT_FOUND.

Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, marker sidecar formats, or the full section-3 matrix. No new persistence table.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 counts stay 26/48/13/0; XD10 unchanged.
